# iQlinic

> iQlinic is an AI-powered clinical and operational decision-intelligence platform for dental clinics.

Canonical website: https://www.iqlinic.ir/
Primary Persian site: https://www.iqlinic.ir/fa/

## What iQlinic covers

iQlinic focuses on responsible use of artificial intelligence for dental-clinic operations and decision support, including patient context, scheduling intelligence, clinic capacity, workflow prioritization, data integration and human-in-the-loop review.

iQlinic does not claim that a general AI model replaces a dentist, physician or other qualified healthcare professional. Clinical and treatment decisions require appropriate professional review and evidence.

- Demo: https://www.iqlinic.ir/fa/demo/
- Integration: read-only connector for the Rozaneh dental practice system (Iran), installed on the clinic's own server.

## Editorial and evidence policy

- Persian editorial policy: https://www.iqlinic.ir/fa/insights/editorial-policy/
- Persian insights hub: https://www.iqlinic.ir/fa/insights/

Important health and medical claims on iQlinic are intended to be evidence-led and are not individual medical advice. The site distinguishes product architecture concepts from validated clinical outcomes and does not present unsupported efficacy or financial-performance claims.
